capabilities: Create toolbars from commands, files, URIs, menus, and scripts
Map toolbars to notes and folders with rules based on paths and properties
Position and style toolbars at the top, bottom, tab bar, or as floating buttons
Embed toolbars inside notes via callouts
Expose an API and CLI for toolbar access and UI helpers
extras: Discloses broad vault file access (read, write, enumerate) mostly for optional scripting and settings features; uses internal Obsidian APIs newer than its declared minAppVersion; detailed documentation lives in an external User Guide; placed runner-up in Obsidian Gems of the Year 2024 (new plugins).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show custom sets of actions per note or folder; users must rely on the command palette, ribbon, or hotkeys.

relations.evidence: Or use the Style Settings plugin for even more options (colors, positioning, sizing, etc.).
Periodic Notes - for code, and one of the reasons this plugin works well for my own needs

summary: Context-aware toolbar plugin that adds customizable toolbars to notes with commands, links, menus, scripts, and flexible display rules.
